name: Rubbing of a Stone from the Tang-Fang Collection
aliases: 東漢武梁祠畫像石拓片
material: Rubbing, ink on paper, horizontal scroll
summary: This rubbing corresponds in composition with stone reliefs from the east wall in stone chamber 3 of the Wu Liang shrine. The upper register illustrates stories of virtuous women. Read from right to left, the last scene in the upper left corner shows a bed under a roof that is labeled “Virtuous Woman
